name: search-browser
title: Search Browser
description: Search open tabs, pinned tabs, bookmarks, and browsing history in Search Browser, open URLs, new windows, and private tabs.
author: eike_stang

preferences.name: searchEngine
preferences.title: Search Engine
preferences.description: Search engine used when searching the web from Search Browser commands.

preferences.name: includeRemoteTabs
preferences.title: iCloud Tabs
preferences.label: Include iCloud tabs from other devices
preferences.description: Show tabs synced via iCloud from your other devices in Search Tabs and Search All.

preferences.name: includePinnedTabs
preferences.title: Pinned Tabs
preferences.label: Include pinned tabs
preferences.description: Include pinned tabs in Search Tabs and Search All.

preferences.name: fetchRemoteFavicons
preferences.title: Online Favicons
preferences.label: Fetch missing favicons online
preferences.description: When disabled, only Search Browser's local cached favicons are used so hostnames are never sent to external favicon services.

tools.name: open-url
tools.title: Open URL
tools.description: Open an HTTP(S) URL or web search query in Search Browser.

ai.instructions: Search Browser's AppleScript dictionary is read-only and intentionally excludes private tabs. History and bookmarks are read from local JSON files on disk. Use open-url only for HTTP/HTTPS URLs or web search queries.

evals.input: @search-browser what tabs do I have open?
